agenda_text:
City Council
AGENDA
la puente City Council City Council
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
JULY 25, 2006
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCILMEMBERS: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Perez, Chavez
BOARD MEMBERS: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Perez, Chavez
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES OF RECOGNITION TO THE T-BALL PIRATES FOR WINNING LA PUENTE NATIONAL LITTLE LEAGUE 2006 T-BALL CHAMPIONS
Certificate
PRESENTATION OF A CERTIFICATE OF APPRECIATION TO THE CITY COUNCIL BY THE AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY FOR SUPPORTING THE 2006 RELAY FOR LIFE
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Redevelopment Agency on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker’s remarks. (Ordinance No. 98-767).
MINUTES
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
A-1.
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF JULY 11, 2006
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of July 11, 2006.
Minutes 7-11-06
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
PUBLIC HEARING - INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE ADOPTING BY REFERENCE TITLE 10, ANIMALS, OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE AND AMENDING CHAPTER 3.36 OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing, (2) take oral testimony, (3) continue the public hearing until August 8, 2006, (4) read the ordinance by title only and waive further reading, and (5) introduce the ordinance for subsequent adoption.
Animals Report
Ordinance
B-2
PUBLIC HEARING - ZONE CHANGE NO. 325 - A PROPOSAL TO CHANGE THE ZONE DESIGNATION OF PROPERTY LOCATED AT 1068 LARIMORE AVENUE FROM R-1 (SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL) TO R-3 (MEDIUM DENSITY RESIDENTIAL)
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing; (2) take public testimony; (3) read ordinance by title only and waive further reading; and (4) introduce the Ordinance approving Zone Change 325 for subsequent adoption.
Zone Change No. 325
Ordinance
B-3
PUBLIC HEARING - INTRODUCTION OF A PROPOSED ORDINANCE ESTABLISHING RATES FOR SEWER SERVICE
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing; (2) take public testimony; (3) read the ordinance by title only and waive further reading; and (4) introduce for subsequent adoption on August 8, 2006.
Sewer Rate Report
Ordinance
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVING A POLICY FOR PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES, COMMENDATIONS, PROCLAMATIONS, PLAQUES AND OTHER RECOGNITION AWARDS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Policy Guidelines for Recognition Requests. CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
Policy for presentations Report
Policy for presentations
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1183 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2005-06
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution. CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR Continued
Warrant Register No. 1183
D-2
FINANCIAL REPORT FOR MONTH ENDED JUNE 30, 2006 (UN-AUDITED)
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the un-audited Monthly Financial Report for the month ended June 30, 2006.
Financial Report
D-3
APPROVAL OF AGREEMENT WITH CHOICES/PHFE MANAGEMENT FOR SOCIAL SERVICES TO THE CITY OF LA PUENTE
It is recommended that the City Council approve and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement with Choices to provide social services to the residents of La Puente.
Choices Report
Coices Agreement
D-4
APPROVAL OF AGREEMENT WITH EAST SAN GABRIEL VALLEY COALITION FOR THE HOMELESS TO PROVIDE SOCIAL SERVICES TO THE HOMELESS
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agreement with the East San Gabriel Valley Coalition for the Homeless and authorize the Mayor to execute the Agreement.
ESGV Coalition Report
ESGV Coalition Agreement
D-5
APPROVAL OF AGREEMENT WITH GIRL SCOUTS - SPANISH TRAILS COUNCIL TO PROVIDE PROGRAMS AND RESOURCES TO THE LA PUENTE COMMUNITY
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agreement with the Girl Scouts - Spanish Trails Council and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement.
Girl Scouts - Spanish Trails Report
Girl Scouts - Spanish Trails Agreement
D-6
APPROVAL OF AGREEMENT WITH YWCA-WINGS ORGANIZATION FOR DOMESTIC VIOLENCE SERVICES TO THE RESIDENTS OF LA PUENTE
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agreement with YWCA-Wings and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement.
Wings Report
Wings Agreement
D-7
APPROVAL OF AGREEMENT WITH SPIRITT FAMILY SERVICES FOR SOCIAL SERVICES TO THE RESIDENTS OF LA PUENTE
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agreement with SPIRITT and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement.
SIRITT Family Services Report
SPIRITT Agreement
D-8
ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION CONFIRMING THE CONTINUED NEED TO MAKE EMERGENCY REPAIRS OF AN IMMINENT HAZARD ON THE HILLSIDE BEHIND 133 AND 139 ROUNDABOUT DRIVE AND 140 AND 148 HILLCREST DRIVE
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution confirming the necessity to make emergency hillside repairs behind 133 and 139 Roundabout Drive and 140 Hillcrest and 148 Hillcrest Drive.
Emergency Repairs Report
Emergency Repairs Resolution
D-9
CONSIDERATION OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM FY 2005-06
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agenda report of the City Manager and authorize that it be filed for audit.
CDBG Housing Rehab Report
D-10
FINAL APPROVAL OF TRACT MAP NO. 62825 TO SUBDIVIDE THE SUBJECT PROPERTY INTO SIX PARCELS FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF FIVE SEPARATE SINGLE-FAMILY TOWNHOMES
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) find that the Final Map complies with all the conditions of approval set forth within Tentative Parcel Map No. 62825; (2) approve the attached subdivision agreement and authorize the Community Development Director to execute the agreement on behalf of the City; and (3) approve the Final Map and instruct the City Clerk to endorse the face of the Final Map, the certificate which embodies the approval of said Map.
Tract Map No. 62825 Report
D-11
CONSIDERATION OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CALHOME HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM ROUND 2
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agenda report of the City Manager and authorize that it be filed for audit.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVING A LEASE AGREEMENT WITH CINGULAR WIRELESS TO LEASE 1160 SQUARE FEET IN LA PUENTE PARK FOR THE CONSTRUCTION AND MAINTENANCE OF A WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATIONS FACILITY
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Lease Agreement with Cingular Wireless PCS, LLC for the lease of 1160 square feet of property located in La Puente Park and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement on the City’s behalf; and (2) direct Staff to investigate the design and cost to construct a community message reader board sign at the corner of Hacienda Boulevard and Temple Avenue.
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION TO IMPLEMENT A PROCESSING CHARGE FOR THE DISMISSAL OF DISABLED PARKING CITATIONS IN ACCORDANCE WITH CALIFORNIA VEHICLE CODE SECTION 40226
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution amending the Parking Violation Penalty Schedule to include enforcement of CVC 40226 as established by law. COUNCIL REPORTS
COUNCIL REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURN CITY COUNCIL AND CONVENE THE REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY MEETINGS
ADOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this
___________________________________
Pat Jacquez-Nares, CMC, City Clerk
